name: Integrated Combat [Combat]
body:
Few opponents know how to fight a foe whose weapons run through their very flesh.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls with implanted weapons. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus to all skill checks made as part of a martial maneuver made with an implanted weapon.
